body.name: Rbase
body.def: Given \(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho}\), \(\mathsf R_{n,\mathcal D(\rho)}^{0,\mathrm{base}}\) is the stage-1 candidate law that assigns independently across strata mass \(\prod_{s\in S}\{\binom{N_{n1s}}{\lfloor\rho N_{n1s}\rfloor}\binom{N_{n1s}}{m_{n1s}}\}^{-1}\) to every element of \(\prod_{s\in S}\Omega_{n,1s}(\rho)\), then recomputes \(X'_{n,s}\) and \(C'_n(\rho)\) from \(\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}\). It generates no stage-2 assignment before the candidate cell is retained.
body.role: explicit pre-cell stage-1 Fisher candidate law
